pricing.p1: The platform is free for renters. Owners pay a commission only on successful bookings, deducted from their share.
pricing.title: Pricing
privacy.l1: We collect only what's needed: name, email, phone and an optional region.
privacy.l2: Passwords are stored as one-way hashes; administrators can't see them.
privacy.l3: Owner phones are visible only to signed-in users; renter phones only to the relevant owner.
privacy.l4: Private messages are never used for recommendations. Marketing is sent only with your consent.
pw.generated: Password generated — write it down somewhere safe
pw.generated_copied: Password generated and copied — save it somewhere safe
pw.must_change: You signed in with a temporary password — set a new one now
pwa.ios1: In Safari, tap Share (□↑) at the bottom
pwa.ios3: Tap Add — CarRent opens like an app and you can sign in with Face ID
pwa.title: Install CarRent on your phone
qb.how: The owner confirms within 24 hours. Nothing is charged now — pay online or on site after confirmation.
qb.note_ph: e.g. I'll pick it up at the airport at 10:00
qb.pick_hint: Tap the pick-up day, then the return day. Busy days can't be selected.
qb.sent_b: {car}: {a} — {b}. You'll get the owner's reply as a notification.
ready.back_hint: Once filled in, you can continue the booking
ready.docs_pending: Your documents are being reviewed — usually within a day
ready.modal_sub: You can't send the request until the items marked in red are done. The link next to each opens the right place.
ready.name: Full name entered
ready.need_sub: So the owner can trust and contact you, you need:
regions.soon_hint: Becomes active once the first car is listed here
regions.title: All regions

rep.h_online_paid: Money received via Click and Payme

rep.i_busy_weekday: Rentals most often start on {wd} — be ready on those days.

rep.i_compensation: You received {sum} compensation for cancelled bookings.
rep.i_gmv_first: Turnover for the period is {sum}, platform income {fee}.
rep.i_idle_car: {car} sat idle for {n} days ({pct}% occupancy). A small price cut or better photos may help.
rep.i_income_down: Income fell {pct}%: {prev} → {sum}. Look at the idle cars below.
rep.i_income_first: You earned {sum} net from {n} rental(s) in this period.
rep.i_income_up: Your income grew {pct}% vs. the previous period: {prev} → {sum}.
rep.i_many_lost: {pct}% of requests were rejected or cancelled. Faster replies and an up-to-date calendar help.
rep.i_no_trips: No rentals in this period. Check your price and make sure your calendar has free days.
rep.i_online_share: About {pct}% of rentals were paid online.
rep.i_pending_now: {n} request(s) are waiting for your reply — they're auto-rejected after 24 hours.
rep.i_pricier_than_market: You paid {avg} per day — {pct}% above similar listings ({market}). The advisor may find cheaper options.
rep.i_rating: Your average rating this period is ★ {avg} ({n} reviews).

rep.i_spent_up: Spending is {pct}% higher than the previous period.
rep.no_online: No online payments in this period
rep.rule: A rental counts toward the period its start date falls in. Only confirmed and completed rentals count as income.
rep.sub_owner: Income, occupancy and how each car performs — in plain words

report.act_confirm: Apply this action? The owner will be notified.
report.sub: An administrator will review it. The owner won't see who reported.
report.title: Send a report
review.ph_renter: Returned on time, followed the terms…
review.thanks: Thank you! Your review was added
reviews.sub: Only real reviews from completed rentals
reviews.title: What users say
sec.session_text: Sessions last 7 days. On a shared computer, sign out when done.
set.channels_off: Email sending (SMTP) isn't configured — codes can't be sent.
set.danger_sub: With no financial history (paid rentals) the account is deleted completely. Otherwise personal data is erased and an anonymous record stays for accounting. Either way you can sign up again with the same email. Not possible while bookings are active.
set.delete_confirm: Your account will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone. Continue?
set.deleted_full: Account deleted completely. You can sign up again with this email
set.logout_all: Sign out of all other devices
set.logout_all_confirm: Sign out everywhere except this device?
set.n_dev: Demo mode: messages go to the test inbox, not real email.
set.n_off: Email or SMS isn't configured yet, so some channels are off.
set.notifications_sub: On-site notifications are always on. Choose extra channels.
set.phone_reverify: Saved. Please verify the new number
set.pw_note: Changing the password signs out other devices and sends you an email.
set.sessions_sub: If you see a device you don't recognise, sign it out and change your password.
set.show_phone_d: If off, renters can only message you. Confirmed bookings still show your number.
set.sms_off: SMS isn't configured — phone verification isn't available yet.
set.verify_sub: Verified email and phone build trust and are needed for password recovery
side.promo_b: List it and earn on the days you don't drive.
terms.breakdown_rule: If not the renter's fault — the owner repairs or replaces the car, days are refunded
terms.check_rule: Check the registration, plate and mileage and confirm; if they don't match — full refund
terms.early_rule: Used days are paid; the rest is refunded, the owner keeps 1 day as compensation
terms.l1: Users are responsible for the accuracy of the information they provide.
terms.l2: Owners hand over the car in the condition and on the terms stated in the listing.
terms.l3: Renters return the car on the agreed date and in the agreed condition.
terms.l4: A confirmed booking can be cancelled before the rental starts; disputes are reviewed by an administrator.
terms.l5: Accounts may be blocked for fake listings, reviews or abusive messages.
terms.on_site_or_online: On site or online (after the owner approves)
terms.owner_cancel_rule: The renter gets a full refund
trust.t1d: Strong passwords and login attempt limits.
trust.t2d: Booked dates are protected at the database level.
trust.t3d: Each review is tied to a completed rental.
trust.title: Trust and safety
uadm.cant_self: An admin account is edited by its owner in Settings
uadm.doc_delete_q: Delete this document? The user will have to upload it again.
uadm.doc_upload: Upload a document for the user
uadm.doc_upload_sub: If the user can't upload (e.g. sent the photo via Telegram), upload it yourself. If ticked, it's approved immediately.
uadm.email_change_note: If the email or phone changes, it becomes unverified
uadm.erase_q: Delete {name}'s account? Without financial history it's deleted completely (with cars, photos, messages); with history, personal data is erased and an anonymous record stays for accounting. Email and phone are freed. This can't be undone.
uadm.erased_anon: Personal data deleted (financial history kept anonymously)
uadm.g1: Read Complaints and Disputes first, then message both sides.
uadm.g2: First offence — Warn: the user gets a notification with the reason.
uadm.g3: Fake listing or suspicious owner — Hide all listings, then investigate.
uadm.g4: Fraud or hijacked account — Block (signs out everywhere) and cancel their bookings.
uadm.g5: Every action is written to the audit log.
uadm.guide: What to do when there's a problem
uadm.h_complaints: Complaints about them, their listings, messages or reviews
uadm.h_o_balance: Online money still owed to them
uadm.h_o_cars: Click for each car's occupancy and revenue
uadm.h_o_trips: Approved and completed rentals of their cars
uadm.h_r_cancel: If high, they may be letting owners down
uadm.make_admin_q: Make {name} an administrator? They will see and manage all users, payments and documents. Only give this to someone you trust.
uadm.note_ph: Internal note (the user won't see it)…
uadm.profile_sub: If the user is stuck or made a mistake, fix it here. Every change is logged and the user is notified.
uadm.pw_sent: A reset code was emailed to the user
uadm.pw_sub: If the user forgot the password and can't access email: create a temporary password and tell them by phone. All sessions are closed; they'll be asked to change it on sign-in.
uadm.pw_temp_q: Create a temporary password for {name}? The old one will stop working.
uadm.readiness_sub: What the user is missing to be able to book
uadm.refund_hint: If unchecked, the cancellation policy applies. For Click/Payme refund in the provider cabinet, then mark it here.
uadm.reports_sub: Each complaint shows who it's about — click to manage them on their page
uadm.sec_hint: If the account is compromised: sign out everywhere and ask the user to reset the password via “Forgot password?”.
